entities.name: Aminomethylthio diazine
observations: Primary amine substrate is represented as CSC1=NC=C(C(C)N)N=N1; its side-chain NH2 is the proposed nucleophile.

entities.name: Bromobenzoic acid
observations: Carboxylic acid substrate is represented generically as O=C(O)C1=CC=CC(Br)=C1; the aryl bromide is predicted to remain unchanged.

entities.name: Benzamide coupling
observations: Carboxylic-acid activation followed by nucleophilic acyl substitution with the side-chain primary amine gives a secondary benzamide.

entities.name: Predicted benzamide product
observations: Proposed connectivity-preserving SMILES: CSC1=NC=C(C(C)NC(=O)c2=CC=CC(Br)=C2)N=N1. Positional aromatic notation should match the exact bromobenzoic-acid input isomer.
